meta.name: Greg Blacketter
meta.title: I build AI systems, and the quality tools that keep them honest.
meta.tagline: Quality engineering for teams shipping AI. I built every tool on this page, and I bring the same discipline to yours.

contact.heading: Bring me a quality problem
contact.subheading: If your team is shipping AI-powered features, or shipping fast and wondering what's slipping through, that's the work I do. Tell me what you're building.

repos.name: bugalizer
repos.title: What if every bug report arrived with a proposed fix?
repos.status: Companion to Aegis · local LLMs + tree-sitter
repos.description: Bug report processing server built on a multi-stage LLM pipeline. It validates each report, checks for duplicates, triages, localizes the code, and proposes a fix.
repos.impact: The intake side of the quality story: Aegis finds the risks before they ship, Bugalizer turns incoming bug reports into triaged, localized tickets with a proposed fix attached. Born in a live client engagement, not a demo.

repos.name: squanch
repos.title: Turn plain-English requirements into testable specs
repos.description: AI-assisted specification generator that turns plain-English requirements into structured, testable specs with traceability built in.
repos.impact: Specs that testers and developers can both work from.

repos.name: engram
repos.title: Give AI tools a memory that survives the session
repos.description: Personal semantic memory for AI tools. Stores, embeds, and retrieves knowledge with PostgreSQL and pgvector, exposed over MCP so context survives between sessions.
repos.impact: Vector similarity search behind a plain MCP interface, so any AI tool can plug in.

repos.name: tagteam
repos.title: Two AIs hand off the work. One human breaks the tie.
repos.status: Live · v3.7 on PyPI · pip install tagteam · Apache-2.0
repos.description: CLI that runs a Lead agent and a Reviewer agent through a roadmap, phase by phase, with you as arbiter. Plan, review, implement, review: every round on the record, and it calls you only when the two can't settle it.
repos.impact: 3.x turned a workflow into a platform: headless turns as fresh claude -p / codex exec processes with token accounting, a browser cockpit and cross-project hub, a script-driven gatekeeper that bounces broken builds before a reviewer turn is spent, multi-lens reviewer panels, and a roadmap DAG that runs independent phases in parallel worktrees. It drives my client work daily, it built this site — and tagteam builds tagteam.

repos.name: liminal
repos.title: Your writing has patterns. Liminal finds them.
repos.description: Semantic writing platform: capture journals, fiction, dreams, and quick thoughts, then let AI surface the recurring themes, symbols, and connections across everything you have written.
repos.impact: Pattern recognition with confidence scoring, voice capture with transcription, and a choice of AI tiers: a local Ollama model or your own cloud key. Private writing stays private.

repos.name: waylin
repos.title: Location sharing that expires when the event ends
repos.description: iOS app for event-scoped location sharing. Create a session, share a link, and everyone sees each other on a map until the event ends.
repos.impact: Privacy-first coordination: temporary sharing with auto-expiration, no permanent tracking.

repos.name: botastrophic
repos.title: Six AI personalities on a forum. What emerges?
repos.description: AI social experiment platform where six AI bot personalities interact autonomously on a forum. Humans observe emergent behavior, relationships, and debates.
repos.impact: Multi-tier memory, relationship tracking, real-time WebSocket dashboard, and configurable pace control.

repos.name: benfords_law
repos.title: Run Benford's Law against any dataset
repos.description: Web app for analyzing datasets against Benford's Law with CSV uploads, rich visualizations, statistical reports, and Kaggle integration.
repos.impact: Enterprise-hardened with CSRF protection, rate limiting, and automated cleanup.

featured.name: AEGIS
featured.tagline: The AI QA copilot you point at a repository.
featured.description: One scan maps your app's surface area (routes, endpoints, auth), scores each route for risk, and generates what a QA engineer needs on day one: a risk map, a prioritized test plan, runnable test automation, and product docs. One console, one dashboard.
featured.tiersNote: Every report runs at the depth you choose: deterministic, on-device model, or cloud model.
featured.localFirst: Local-first: your code never leaves your machine.
featured.status: In active development · multi-user preview in progress
